payload.purpose_context: The #739 policy asks Kent for a missing appointment start-time and, per option (iii), should fall back to an all-day event if unanswered. Today the 24h clarification sweep just drops the pending record, so the appointment is re-asked every window but never scheduled. This mission adds a deterministic age-out to create-all-day fallback, scoped strictly to start-time-missing clarifications, reusing the already-shipped all-day calendar-helper support (#786) and the #746 route_and_finalize transaction for idempotent, atomic scheduling.
payload.purpose_tldr: When a no-time appointment's start-time clarification goes unanswered for 24h, land it on the calendar as an all-day event instead of re-asking forever.
